trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Nothing separate to do: it unlocks after the other 54. In practice the last pieces are the 100% checklist and the cleanup collectibles, so plan the whole save around A Long Road.
steps: Check each other trophy off in the tracker
Finish with A Long Road (100%) and One Last Thing

sources.name: KeenGamer, GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end

trophies.guide: A named story mission, Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy: it pops by itself when you finish it, and PowerPyx reports it cannot be missed.
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory as it comes up in the story

sources.name: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as mirrored by Exophase/PSNProfiles and the make.fun kit

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, PowerPyx and KeenGamer agree: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist after the story. Most other trophies here feed it, so do them first and let the checklist show what remains.
steps: Work the Progress menu until it reads 100%

sources.name: KeenGamer, GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do 250 stunts out of the roughly 397 in the game (PowerPyx count), in any mix. PowerPyx calls the Under the Bridges type the quickest; the Progress menu tracks them by region.
steps: Chain the quick under-the-bridge type first

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of nine activity types once (per PowerPyx: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, a race or drone race, and a stunt). Most players finish it without trying.
steps: Let the remaining one or two be your first detour

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Get gold on every shooting range challenge: PowerPyx counts 42 gold medals across 12 ranges. Do them slowly; there are no mission medals elsewhere, so this is the one place accuracy matters.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total, per PowerPyx). These also count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not count. Mix street races and drone races if drone races count for you, then check the counter.
steps: Find new races on the map

sources.name: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as mirrored by Exophase/PSNProfiles and the make.fun kit

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1's Feng Shui mission, Cal texts you a fishing challenge marker west of Key Lento (PowerPyx). Beat him in it.
steps: Follow Cal's text to the marker

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Beat any one arcade game to its end. It also counts toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger questline. PowerPyx says quest givers return after the story, so this is not missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger questline. PowerPyx says his line returns later in the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger questline. Not missable per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger strands. PowerPyx warns only some count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Moses, Andy and Billy do not. Do not assume every stranger counts.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline to its last mission. Not missable per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline to its last mission. Not missable per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy PowerPyx and KeenGamer call potentially missable. It needs all 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia (last one unlocks after Chapter 2). Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house after the kitchen scene before the chapter ends; the guide is unsure it is required but did it.
steps: Track the rest under Progress, Collections, Exploration
Do paired spots with both characters

sources.name: KeenGamer, GTA 6 trophy guide and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Start Bret's hunting quest as Jason (Lucia does not get his messages) and hunt what he asks for. PowerPyx suggests completing all 15 Target Decks gets it naturally but did not confirm which animal triggers it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK scan at 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags, per PowerPyx.
steps: Scan every scan point you pass

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 challenges. PowerPyx suggests leaving it for last since the 100% checklist completes many of them anyway.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and leave the red search zone. PowerPyx suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia and says it also pops in the big bank vault mission.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2, rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level. PowerPyx suggests the three jewelry stores in north Vice City after Yasmani's jobs, armor and sticky bombs. It pops about 30 seconds after the third; rob a fourth if it does not.
steps: Rob three stores back to back

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles, mostly by scanning traffic with WAiNK (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus use. PowerPyx suggests an assault rifle, boosting focus with food or a shower, and gang-operation enemies, since civilians and police do not count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA steal a large airliner docked at a boarding bridge (PowerPyx suggests terminals E3/E4), take off and fly about 1 km out. The unlock is delayed.
steps: Steal the plane at the gate
Fly about 1 km away and wait

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County and shoot some enemies (PowerPyx).
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's jobs give you the Snap Gun, rob a jewelry store via the back door, undetected, opening the safe with the backroom code and killing the alarm and footage. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
steps: Disable alarm and footage, open safe

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults, unlocked after "That's Where The Money Is". Expect a 4-star wanted level; a fast bike helps. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 (PowerPyx).
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and get away. Use a fast vehicle to break the chase; no further detail from my sources.

sources.name: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as mirrored by Exophase/PSNProfiles and the make.fun kit

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map; PowerPyx's tip is to do it from the air.
steps: Fly the plane over the fogged regions

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation for each of the 9 gangs (PowerPyx says 39 exist for 100%).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy and drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: With the Key Cloner, take the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive through the window. Only that car counts (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: During "Hit Kingpin Bowling" steal all three valuables and escape; you can return later for ones you missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get both characters to max strength at once by working out together at fitness clubs (PowerPyx).
steps: Train with your partner at gyms

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PowerPyx says it comes from reaching 500 criminal-profile actions, which happens naturally. Running over civilians or cops speeds it up.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: After "Credit Check", rob the same Payday Loans store in Little Cuba as Lucia alone and escape on foot; the pop is delayed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the UFO near Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM, alone, follow the path into the woods and return the woman to her car. The spawn is random (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians from a bike within 60 seconds in a crowded area (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Deliver $250,000 in marked bills to a fence, cumulative across robberies. Yasmani pays best; opens after "Credit Check" (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops, mainly guns, car mods and tattoos (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 purchasable garages (about $160,000) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after "Daily Driver" (PowerPyx).
steps: Buy the garages in the app

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app via Moses in Port Gellhorn. Have garage space first; cheap cars keep fees low (PowerPyx).

roadmap.title: Opening and Chapter 1
roadmap.note: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter ends: the only trophy sources call missable.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2 and 3 story
roadmap.note: Finishing Chapter 2 unlocks the crime content for later stages.

roadmap.title: Finish the story
roadmap.note: Late story missions and the finale; quest givers stay available after.

roadmap.title: Crime and heists (after Chapter 2)
roadmap.note: Bank vaults, shop robberies, plane, tank, gang operations.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, activities, side quests
roadmap.note: Counts and sets; tick them off in any order.

roadmap.title: 100% and platinum
roadmap.note: Last: One Last Thing, A Long Road, then the platinum.

onlineNote: GTA VI has no online trophies in the list used here; the online filter is shown empty.
